title: Spinach Noodi Dumplings with Sage Butter
subtitle: made with fresh cheese and Grana Padano
description: Soft spinach and cheese dumplings in a classic sage and lemon butter sauce, finished with plenty of grated Grana Padano.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a pan and toss the spinach for a few seconds only, until it starts to shrink. Cool.
In a bowl, mix the fresh cheese, 125 g grated Grana Padano, egg yolk, nutmeg, flour and semolina to an even mixture. Add the spinach, season with salt and pepper and mix.
Divide the dough into 30 equal pieces and shape each into an elongated dumpling.

Bring plenty of salted water to the boil in a large, wide pot and reduce the heat. Cook half of the dumplings for 3 minutes, until they start to float. Lift out with a slotted spoon into a bowl and cook the rest.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the sage leaves and lemon juice and cook for about 1 minute.
Pour the butter sauce over the dumplings, sprinkle with the remaining Grana Padano and serve.
